definitionsAndBoundaries: ProjectGuid rejects nil only; no UUID version/variant enforcement and no cross-project uniqueness lookup.
ProjectManifestDigest is BLAKE3 over caller-supplied raw bytes. This API performs no file read, size bound, provenance check, freshness check, or content-to-current-file verification.
The digest wire representation is exactly 64 lowercase ASCII hexadecimal characters; serialization and deserialization use that canonical form.

ProjectIdentity stores a descriptor identity, GUID, and digest supplied by its caller. Its Serde derive applies component representations only; it does not canonicalize a physical path, read a manifest, compare a digest to disk, or grant admission.
CanonicalDescriptorIdentity is a lexical path-shape value. Physical resolution and path/content revalidation are performed by caller boundaries.

derivesAndAttributes: ProjectGuid derives Serialize and uses #[serde(transparent)]; Deserialize is manual and routes through the nil guard.
ProjectManifestDigest implements Serialize/Deserialize manually; Deserialize routes through parse.
ProjectIdentity derives Serialize and Deserialize for its component fields.
